risk_explanation: Jinja2 2.11.3 is incompatible with modern versions of MarkupSafe, leading to an ImportError when attempting to import 'soft_unicode'. Upgrading to Jinja2 3.x resolves this conflict and maintains compatibility with current dependencies.
steps: Update Jinja2 from 2.11.3 to 3.1.6 in requirements.txt to resolve MarkupSafe incompatibility.
